label: Bible Study
prompt: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will _____ and be glad in it.
verse: This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
note: The sung-before-breakfast verse — rejoicing here is a decision, made daily.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is my _____ and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
verse: The LORD is my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he is my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father's God, and I will exalt him.
note: Israel's first recorded song, sung on the far side of the Red Sea, still barely dry.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Remember the _____ day, to keep it holy.
verse: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy.
note: The fourth commandment starts with 'Remember' — as if God knew we'd be inclined to forget.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Where wast thou when I laid the _____ of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
verse: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.
note: God's opening question from the whirlwind — Job's résumé suddenly looked very short.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye blind guides, which strain at a _____, and swallow a camel.
verse: Ye blind guides, which strain at a gnat, and swallow a camel.
note: Strain at a gnat, swallow a camel — the smallest unclean creature versus the largest.
